thread:
maria: Heads-up: found a staging repro where hedging + midstream EOF caused two regions to finish the same request and both increment billing.
aj: Oof. Do we know which component decided the request was final on both sides?
maria: Gateway A saw EOF mid-frame, applied our "treat-EOL-as-final" rule and committed. Gateway B was hedged and got slightly more tokens, also committed.
dennis: That implies our finality invariant isn't globally coordinated. We need a minimal cross-proxy handshake to avoid double-commit.
kyle: Current heuristic: trailers or explicit "x-stream-final" header -> final. QUIC doesn't have trailers so we rely on content-length or EOF. That's brittle.
anita: Short term mitigation: when EOF-without-trailer occurs, delay final billing by a tiny window (configurable, default 80-150ms) to let hedges surface.
aj: Can we make that window per-route? Some low-latency routes can't tolerate 100ms.
maria: Yes — route config: hedging.grace_ms (default 100, min 0, max 300). For latency-sensitive routes set 0 and accept possible duplicates; for cost-sensitive set >0.
dennis: But even with grace window, races could happen at scale. We need a stronger guard: add a monotonic resume sequence id emitted by the runtime: header `x-resume-id: 12345`.
kyle: Proposed handshake: when hedging, hedged path must include `x-resume-id` and the edge will only accept a completion if resume-id > last_committed_resume_id. The runtime guarantees monotonicity for a session.
anita: Billing layer change: make finalization an atomic CAS on (tenant, request_id, commit_resume_id). If CAS fails, drop duplicate billing and mark path as stale.
aj: How will this behave for long-tail retries across regions? The resume-id may lag; need TTL for resume-id acceptance. Maybe commit_resume_id TTL = 10s?
maria: We should also add a per-tenant cool-down: when a commit succeeds, disable hedging for that tenant for 5s to reduce rapid duplicates.
dennis: Telemetry: emit `hedge.attempt`, `hedge.accepted`, `hedge.rejected_resume_mismatch`, `billing.duplicate_detected`. Alert if `billing.duplicate_detected` > 0 for a tenant within 1h.
kyle: Implementation checklist for gateway: 1) accept and propagate `x-resume-id`, 2) check resume-id on hedged completions, 3) support route hedging.grace_ms, 4) signal trace span `path.finality=uncertain` until CAS commit.
anita: Docs + SDK: call out that QUIC streams may be more prone to ambiguous finality; recommend app-level idempotency keys for side-effecting endpoints.
aj: Long-term design: optional coordinator service for cross-region two-phase commit for high-value tenants. Prepare phase records token-window snapshot, commit finalizes billing. Enable by opt-in.
maria: Risk list: added latency for some routes, more complexity in billing path, potential new failure modes if CAS backend is slow. Need canary run and sim harness to fuzz split EOF scenarios.
sre-bot: Canary window requested: 02:00-04:00 UTC next Tuesday. Please add runbook for rollback if `billing.duplicate_detected` spikes.
maria: I'll draft an RFC with config schema, runtime resume-id contract, billing CAS API, and the sim harness. Will include default route configs and migration plan.
